answer: A trust atlas starts from independently vetted sponsors, each with one unit of outgoing endorsement capacity per epoch. Newcomer payouts are bounded by max-flow from those roots. A bridge into a clone cluster carries the same total capacity for one identity or a thousand; internal endorsements add none. Random work audits shine a lantern on sham links and revoke sponsors' capacity for fabricated receipts. A farm must earn or buy scarce endorsements instead of merely generating keys; honest roots remain an assumption.
